GOAL: Make concurrent identical POST /api/directives retries converge to the already accepted run required by final DOC-C without weakening session/request fingerprint isolation.
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: If a P2002 is caused by a concurrent winner for the same idempotency key, re-resolve the durable idempotency record.
Return the original accepted run only when sessionId and exact requestHash match the authenticated request.
Preserve conflict/fail-closed behavior for a different session, different request fingerprint, conflicting directive identity, or unresolved persistence state.
Concurrent retries must not create a second PipelineRun, DirectiveRecord, DirectiveDispatch, EventLog, or AuditLog for the duplicate request.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not turn all P2002 errors into idempotent success.
Do not weaken SERIALIZABLE acceptance or unique constraints.
Do not mutate NEXY.AI-Test-AI directly while isolated worker branch law remains blocked.
ACCEPTANCE: A deterministic concurrency/race test forces both requests past the initial idempotency lookup before one transaction wins.
Winner returns the canonical accepted run.
Equivalent loser converges to the same directive_id/run_id rather than 409.
Same key plus different payload/session remains rejected.
No duplicate durable accepted records are created.
Existing directive contract/security/queue-failure tests remain green.
Independent exact-SHA review and post-integration reverify complete.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker branch namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
